Remarks: Considering the limitations of the available fish studies, the FEEDAP Panel set a maximum dietary safe level for ornamental fish using the lowest NOAEL (500 mg/kg bw per day) and applying an uncertainty factor of 100, as described in the FEEDAP Panel guidance for additives already authorised for use in food (EFSA FEEDAP Panel, 2012).
